introductionComments.title: introductionComments
introductionComments.description: Any comments to include from the context of how the referral was created. Summarize the context or comments to be one to three sentences max.

recordId.title: recordId
recordId.description: Record ID of the related account.

referralCreatedOn.title: referralCreatedOn
referralCreatedOn.description: Date and time the referral was created. This is already set to current date and time by default so need to provide input here.

targetLOB.title: targetLOB
targetLOB.description: Target line of business the referral is for. The picklist values for this input are any one of these options: CMC, Consumer Investments, Wealth, Private Bank, Business Banking, Commercial Bank, Global Markets, Lending, Mortgage.
